    About this build

    This is an observability tool, not an antivirus: it never blocks, quarantines, or modifies anything on its own. It surfaces facts. See WIP.md in the repository for exactly what's verified vs. experimental in the current build.

    Rules
    
          
        
    
        
    
          Detection rules live as YAML files in the rules/
          directory and are evaluated by the same
          offgrd-rules engine the CLI uses. Edit the YAML
          directly (see CONTRIBUTING.md) and hit Refresh, or
          use "Scan now" on the Alerts page to test changes.
